systems.name: Dry masonry finish
systems.direction: Develop authored two-coat mineral plaster with pure silicate finish; retain conventional24 plaster as control
systems.scope: Renderable bare mineral masonry only; not gypsum, timber, coated boards or an assumed smooth concrete face
systems.constituents: Named Conserv NHL2/sand and BEECK powder/standard Fixative are the component controls. Key, repairs, edge mesh and delivered composition remain to establish.
systems.firstRelease: Remove independently screwed trim; locally repair plaster and recoat. Plaster is sacrificial, not demountable.
systems.residue: Actual background, adapted10+4 application and surface trial are not manufacturer approval; extra key consumes allowance. No material admission.

systems.name: Located wet lining
systems.direction: Carry the complete30 principal wet assembly; apply to other actual splash zones only after their own set-out
systems.scope: Principal bathroom selected internal reference; family/rear wet fields require explicit limits and wall returns
systems.constituents: Mineral faces do not remove concealed bonded membrane/tape/collars, grout, movement seal or fixings.
systems.firstRelease: Isolate wet use; release screen/trim and sacrificial lower tiles; renew and test the complete disturbed water boundary.
systems.residue: Known/unknown synthetic wet-system constituents remain unapproved. Never silently transfer30 to Bed3 or the family service cabinet.

systems.name: Dry solid-timber floor
systems.direction: Mechanically fixed unfinished solid boards over discrete timber grounds; no engineered-board or full-glue default
systems.scope: Dry rooms;22 board reallocates2 from the60 functional layer while keeping80 total and existing FFL
systems.constituents: Whole sawn timber, metal fasteners and disclosed hard packing. Moisture, acoustic, finish and any required barrier remain explicit functions.
systems.firstRelease: Clear furniture; remove local skirting; expose top fixings or sacrifice the first board; structure and all fire boundaries remain.
systems.residue: This is a carpentry reference, not an altered manufacturer package. Required moisture protection cannot be omitted; no bare-oak complete material pass.

systems.name: Mineral floor / wet floor
systems.direction: Stone or ceramic on a complete mineral substrate; retain required water boundary in wet rooms
systems.scope: Bathrooms, guest WC splash field and service/working rooms as located; door saddles and movement joints are separate actual interfaces
systems.constituents: Stone/ceramic and binder are not enough: grout, bedding chemistry, collars and movement seals remain in scope.
systems.firstRelease: Lift a sacrificial local finish patch only after isolation; retain independent supported structure; renew disturbed wet and service seals.
systems.residue: Substrate load, flatness/falls, complete mixture and slip/cleaning evidence remain required. Dry mineral fields do not automatically need room tanking.

systems.name: Ceiling beneath RC200
systems.direction: Treat the actual slab as the prospective fire boundary; use an ordinary non-protective finish below it
systems.scope: Ground rooms beneath the actual first RC floor; no duplicate rated ceiling by default
systems.constituents: Actual mineral facing/support/joints and decorations; RC fire resistance, cover, openings and loads stay with STR.
systems.firstRelease: Open a genuinely independent service cover; do not remove the qualified slab/penetration boundary.
systems.residue: Neither a15 skin nor RC200 as a name proves REI30. Ordinary and protective layers are distinct.

systems.name: Upper protected roof closure
systems.direction: Locate the actual EI30 duty, exposure and roof support first; compare complete tested systems, not a bare board
layers: CL SLUX EI60 control steel C
systems.scope: Upper protected ring/stair below roof only;176 is a finite bidirectional control, not a whole-house adoption
infill: stone mineral wool within C web
systems.constituents: Promat CL SLUX-EI60-024S includes all steel, fillets, two12 skins and stone wool. A1 board is not proof of polymer absence.
systems.firstRelease: Isolate the affected protected volume; access only through an applicable complete rated hatch or reconstruct the classified closure.
systems.residue: Actual rating/exposure/datum/seats/spans and complete assembly chemistry remain open. Do not automatically spend106 or remove wool/binder.

systems.name: Independent trim
systems.direction: Retain ordinary150x18 skirting,70x18 architrave and local normal-to-wall release
systems.scope: Dry trim; optional ceiling cover only where an actual joint needs it
systems.constituents: Solid timber, accessible metal screws, removable wood plugs; exact wall grounds/anchors and finish disclosed.
systems.firstRelease: Remove the short door-end first; no mitre, paint bridge or service attachment locks trim to the frame.
systems.residue: The decorative member carries no fire/water/service duty. No nylon plug or filler is silently approved.

systems.name: Fixed cabinets and wardrobes
systems.direction: Use solid frame-and-panel joinery, captured backs and replaceable shelves; design out routine sheet-board glue
systems.scope: Actual HAD external envelopes remain fixed; no universal hinged/sliding operation is inferred
systems.constituents: Whole timber, pegged/bolted/rebated joints, actual hardware. Do not extend glue deletion to a certified doorset or structural component.
systems.firstRelease: Isolate services; remove an independent door/shelf/back or supported worktop; leave basin/fixture supports independent.
systems.residue: Wardrobe tracks, drawer bearings, kitchen wet edges, finishes and exact storage/use remain admission work. Flat external dimensions do not prove internal capacity.

systems.name: Joinery paint / clear finish
systems.direction: Use a disclosed linseed-paint family for ordinary timber; delete gratuitous clearcoat and retain a repairable thin finish
systems.scope: Ordinary trim/cabinet timber only, not automatic floor or rated-door coating approval
systems.constituents: Brouns product control includes boiled oil/pigment, a drying agent and its actual primer/shellac requirements; natural is not a full declaration.
systems.firstRelease: Clean and locally prepare/recoat; do not bridge mechanical release joints. Replace a damaged sacrificial piece where needed.
systems.residue: Dryer, pigment, knotting/primer and actual fire/cleaning suitability remain unadmitted. No generic natural-oil approval.

systems.name: Protected-route doors and glazing
systems.direction: Retain a complete applicable rated assembly and all its required components; prefer ordinary hinged operation where geometry permits
systems.scope: Only occurrences in HAD’s actual protected-volume ledger; internal dwelling closer duty is not automatic
systems.constituents: Leaf/core/glues, frame/lipping, intumescent/smoke seals, hinge pads, locks, glazing, packing and perimeter seal all remain.
systems.firstRelease: Release trim independently; support/unfix the actual frame only for a planned boundary intervention; close the affected route and reinstate/test.
systems.residue: The Howdens/Lorient control explicitly contains PVC-encased intumescent; retain required safety constituents, with material admission/owner disposition held.

systems.name: Other internal doors / folding screens
systems.direction: Ordinary solid frame/panel carpentry or a complete matched screen, within the actual operating/parking envelope
systems.scope: Internal bathroom/wardrobe closures outside the protected boundary are separately classified; no rated duty is presumed absent merely from a label
systems.constituents: Timber/metal/glass faces plus actual guides, bearings, seals, fasteners and finishes.
systems.firstRelease: Support moving leaf/panels; remove accessible hardware without consuming the mineral opening; restore any actual boundary.
systems.residue: Do not replace an accepted fire leaf with untested glue-free carpentry. The principal folding-screen target remains a compatibility requirement.

systems.name: Ironmongery
systems.direction: Prefer plain uncoated stainless/brass bodies with accessible metal fixing and replaceable ordinary bearings
systems.scope: Hinges, pulls, latches, wardrobe tracks and guards; rated hardware remains part of its actual assembly
systems.constituents: Inspect clear lacquer, bushings, lubricants, nylon rollers, closer internals and fixings—not the metal face alone.
systems.firstRelease: Expose screws, support the leaf and exchange the real component; retain seals and tested hinge protection where required.
systems.residue: Plain metal is a construction direction, not a disclosed whole product or exception.

systems.name: Sanitaryware and worktops
systems.direction: Carry the matched enamel-tray reference, plain ceramic basins/WC/bath and mechanically supported plain stainless wet-worktop direction
systems.scope: Principal/rear/family wet rooms, guest WC and actual kitchen/utility fixtures; no invented household appliance count
systems.constituents: Include tray support/pads, cistern and seat, mixer cartridges, overflow, waste, backing, clamps and complete joints.
systems.firstRelease: Use the specific1232 split renewal for principal; each other occurrence needs its own supported connection and withdrawal.
systems.residue: The B568 plastic/PP and wet seals remain unapproved. A ceramic pan or stainless bowl does not clear the connected assembly.

systems.name: Concealed boundaries and terminals
systems.direction: Minimise the cavity; independently support service/lighting devices and retain compatible certified closures
systems.scope: All rooms, protected-route junctions, service covers and roof/ceiling transitions
systems.constituents: Fire/acoustic compounds, collars, mesh/board binders, cable/terminal insulation, sleeves, boards and substrate preparation are in scope.
systems.firstRelease: Isolate; open the actual face while retaining the primary boundary where possible; cap/isolate any opened annulus and reinstate/test.
systems.residue: Do not remove insulation, fire stop, seal or required lining to manufacture a polymer-free label.
